title: SVMap 1.2 sim/match.json
description: Player-count rules on actors and win targets by team size (match.md). The validator also checks what a schema cannot: actors and missions exist, min is not above max, key positions only on movers, no rule on a conveyor.

rules.description: One entry per gated actor, in any order; an actor has at most one rule.

win.description: Win targets by team size, one entry per mission at most.

players.description: A player count: 0 (no limit) or 1 to 24.

key.description: A mover placed at this key (Engine.Mover KeyPos[8]) and locked there.

actor.description: The id of an actor in sim/gameplay.json (any class but Svm.Conveyor); ids match ignoring ASCII case.

players.description: [min, max]: the actor is in the match when the round's player count is inside the range.

outside.description: The state outside the range: hidden or a key (never normal). Default: key 0 for a mover, hidden for anything else.

inside.description: The state inside the range (default normal).

mission.description: The id of an SMission actor.

bySize.description: 12 counts, [0] for 1v1 to [11] for 12v12: 0 keeps the mission's own MinimumObjectives, else the completions the spies need.
